title: Persist and verify calibration drafts
description: Register calibration drafts and observations in local persistence, workspace portability, migration, reference-aware deletion, and focused browser/artifact tests for the complete evidence-safe workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Drafts and observations autosave, restore, migrate, export, import, and delete through established registries
Portability preserves exact references, artifacts, diagnostics, and demo versus physical provenance
Import and deletion failures are atomic and leave last-known-good state intact
Keyboard browser tests cover valid transitions, refusals, restoration invalidation, generation, provenance, completion, and focus/status behavior
Artifact tests parse calibration geometry while making no physical placement claim

steps.details: Add calibration drafts and observations to repository, migration, portability, reference, and deletion registries with supported schema versions.
Expose earlier assumptions, semantic progress, associated errors, announced refusals/status, persistent provenance labels, and focus-safe restoration.
Round-trip small fixtures and inject import, persistence, and deletion failures to verify atomic last-known-good behavior.
Exercise the keyboard journey and parsed artifact checks for valid, refused, stale, demo, physical-provenance, and completion states.
Run focused unit and Playwright filters plus type, lint, and build checks relevant to calibration changes.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use intentionally small fixtures and focused browser filters.
This verifies software state and artifact structure only; PRD 26 remains blocked by unavailable physical evidence.
